name: lsu_accept
supersedes: protocol-v4.json (h100-v4r1 / b300-v4r1, both runs identical: the store issue gap is NOT a request-count queue -- stg16 W=1/2 never knee up to 24 requests while W=4 knees at 8 and W=8 at 4 per warp, stg4 W=4 knees at 16 to a 64 B/cycle aggregate and W=8 at 6 to 64 then 32 B/cycle; decision none under v4's frozen rules)
mechanisms: storage.global.store_issue (new, cluster-local): the SMSP's issue interval of a global / local store as a function of its sector count (h100 v4r1: 4 sectors 4 cycles, 16 sectors 24 cycles per warp, W = 1 and 2 alike)

storage.global.store_queue (new engine rule, leaf fields on memory.store_l2.capacity): a per-SM two-stage byte queue in front of the SM store port -- stage A (LSU / L1 acceptance, rate r_a, capacity C_a bytes) feeding stage B (the SM store port, rate = installed store_l2.sector_bytes_per_cycle, capacity C_b bytes); a store cannot issue while stage A has no room for its bytes (ncu `stall_lg`)
question: v4r1 gap profiles (table.md of lsu_accept-model/<dev>-v4r1): one warp issues STG.128 every 24 cycles and STG.32 every 4 cycles with no knee up to 24 requests; four warps on four SMSPs issuing STG.128 run at 32 cycles each (64 B/cycle aggregate) for 8 requests and then at 64 (32 B/cycle = the installed store port) for the rest; eight warps knee after 4 requests to 128 (again 32 B/cycle); four warps of STG.32 run at 4 cycles for 16 requests then 8 (64 B/cycle aggregate); eight warps of STG.32 run 4, then 16 (64 B/cycle) from request 7, then 32 (32 B/cycle) from request ~20. What are (1) the SMSP's store issue interval as a function of the request's sectors, (2) the acceptance rate r_a and capacity C_a of the stage every store enters at issue, and (3) the capacity C_b of the stage drained by the SM store port?

engine_rules_declared_before_data.baseline: present engine (task/fg-producer 56e2c689): STG / ST / STL issue_interval 0 on lsu_smsp; MemoryHierarchy::store chains sectors through the shared L2 write service and the per-SM store port; nothing gates issue.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.I (store issue interval): a global / local store (MACC access_kind store, space global or local; atomics excluded) occupies its SMSP's store issue for cycles(storage.global.store_issue) from its issue cycle (template-level TIME row, kind global_store_issue_interval_smsp, per-SMSP next-admission like kind 5); leaf: cycles piecewise-linear in the capture axis sector_count (points at 4, 8, 16 sectors from stg4 / stg8 / stg16 W = 1, each = median gap minus the clock read's own cost (none cell gap - 1)); the row's admission start is the store's issue floor (resource bucket).
engine_rules_declared_before_data.Q2 (two-stage per-SM byte queue): per SM, requests in order of issue with bytes B_k (sum of sector bytes): t_a(k) = max(issue_k, t_a(k-1)) + B_k / r_a is when the request has left stage A; it may not leave A before stage B has room: t_a(k) >= t_b(j) for the latest j with sum_{i=j+1..k} B_i > C_b; t_b(k) = max(t_a(k), t_b(k-1)) + B_k / r_b with r_b = store_l2.sector_bytes_per_cycle (the SM store port; the shared L2 write service stays where MemoryHierarchy::store puts it); the request's issue is blocked (resource bucket, retry at that cycle) until stage A has room: issue_k >= t_a(j) for the latest j with sum_{i=j+1..k} B_i > C_a. Leaf fields (memory.store_l2.capacity): store_l2.accept_bytes_per_cycle = r_a, store_l2.accept_queue_bytes = C_a, store_l2.drain_queue_bytes = C_b (measured).
engine_rules_declared_before_data.Q1 (single stage): Q2 with stage A removed (C_a = C_b, r_a = infinity): issue blocked while the bytes pending at the SM store port exceed C_b.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.prediction: replaying the probe schedule through I + Q2 (model_store_queue_tandem.py: W warps, each issuing 24 requests of B bytes at the measured issue interval, blocked by stage A room) reproduces every cell's 24 gaps: stg16 W = 4 plateaus 32 -> 64 with the knee where 4 x 8 x 512 B issued minus r_b x elapsed exceeds C_a + C_b; stg4 W = 4 plateaus 4 -> 8 (= 4 x 128 / r_a, r_a ~ 64 B/cycle) once C_a fills, stg4 W = 8 then 16 -> 32 once C_b fills too. Q1 cannot produce the intermediate 64 B/cycle plateau of stg4 W = 4 / 8 and is expected to fail there.

probe: tools/microbench/lsu_accept/probe/store_queue.cu (v4 probe + variants stg8 = st.global.v2.b32 256 B per request and none = 24 clock reads with no store): one CTA of 32*W threads, W in {1, 2, 4, 8} (warp w on SMSP w % 4), bar.sync + fence.sc.gpu + bar.sync before every repetition, lane 0 of each warp records 25 %clock64 stamps around 24 back-to-back stores on 24 distinct pointer registers (each request its own 128 B-aligned region, distinct per warp and per k). Rows: per (variant, W, k) the gap t_k - t_{k-1}; u = 0 the window total. --launches 16 --reps 65, two runs per device (the v5 runs are the gate; v4r1 is the prior the model shape was checked against).
sass_gate: tools/microbench/lsu_accept/sass_check_store_queue.py: 25 SR_CLOCKLO reads in the loop, exactly one STG of the variant's width (none: no STG) between consecutive reads and no other memory / barrier / fence / branch instruction; 24 distinct address registers; control words recorded.
derivation: tools/microbench/lsu_accept/model_store_queue_tandem.py: (1) clock cost c0 = median gap of none W = 1 (k = 2..24); issue interval t(S) = median gap (k = 2..24) of stg4 / stg8 / stg16 at W = 1 minus (c0 - 1), S = 4 / 8 / 16 sectors; the W = 2 cells must agree with W = 1 within 15 % or 1 cycle (per-SMSP structure), else the interval is reported and not installed. (2) r_b = installed store_l2.sector_bytes_per_cycle (B/cycle). (3) grid search (C_a, C_b in 512 B steps 512..32768; r_a in {32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256} B/cycle) replaying each cell of stg4 / stg8 / stg16 at W in {2, 4, 8} through I + Q2 with per-warp issue times = max(previous + t(S) + (c0 - 1), stage-A room) and ties between warps blocked on the same room go to the longest-waiting warp; score = sum over cells and k = 2..24 of |predicted gap - measured gap|; the minimum-score point is the candidate. Acceptance: in every cell >= 75 % of the gaps k = 2..24 within 15 % or 4 cycles of the measurement and >= 85 % over all cells, and the two v5 runs select grid points within one step of each other for C_a / C_b and the same r_a. (Threshold chosen before the v5 runs but with the v4r1 dry replay in view: Q2 at (4096, 5632, 64) reproduces h100 / b300 v4r1 at 17-23 / 20-23 of 23 gaps per cell; the known miss is stg16 W = 4's first plateau, 32 measured vs 24 predicted, a per-SM effect the two-stage model does not carry and that is recorded, not fitted.) Q1 is scored on the same grid (r_a = infinity) and installed only if Q2 fails and Q1 passes. none -> report, unrealised.
install: schema_registry fields (memory_level: store_l2.accept_bytes_per_cycle bytes/cycle, store_l2.accept_queue_bytes bytes, store_l2.drain_queue_bytes bytes); common mechanism storage.global.store_issue (program event issue, timing_kind global_store_issue_interval_smsp, classes STG / ST / STL, parameter timing_row, cycles linear over capture axis sector_count registered in common/axes.json) with per-device leaves (measured, source lsu_accept.<device>.v5r<n>); engine: kind handled like kind 5 (per-SMSP next admission, shared-space veto inverted: only non-shared MACC), the two-stage queue in MemoryHierarchy (per-SM deque of (bytes, t_a, t_b)) consulted by try_issue before register checks and fed at issue by the store path; CTest fixtures (issue interval: 4 x 16-sector STG on one warp spaced t(16); queue: one warp's stores beyond C_a + C_b blocked until the port drains); A/B full-gpu 500 x 2 and single-cluster 500 x 2 against the current baseline.
not_allowed: no case tuning; no change to the derivation after the data; a device whose runs fail the SASS gate or the acceptance stays disabled (enabled 0) and is reported.

addenda.written: after h100-v5r1 / b300-v5r1 (SASS gate 4 / 4 kernels on both; run-a == run-b on both; model_store_queue_tandem.py)
addenda.text: (reading) Store issue interval I passes on both devices and is installed: c0 = 2, t(4 sectors) = 3, t(8) = 6, t(16) = 23 cycles per SMSP, identical on h100 and b300 and across runs / W = 1-2 (leaf storage.global.store_issue, piecewise-linear in sector_count). The queue candidates fail the frozen acceptance on both devices: I + Q2 best grid point h100 (C_a 4096 / 4608, C_b 7168, r_a 64), b300 (4096, 6656, 64) -- stg16 W = 4 / 8 16-21 / 23, stg4 W = 4 / 8 21-23 / 23, but stg8 W = 4 9-10 / 23 and W = 8 12-14 / 23: 256 B requests run at 146 B/cycle (W = 4, 20 requests before the port plateau) and 85 B/cycle (W = 8) where the model throttles them at 64; I + Q1 (single stage, C_b 11776) misses the 64 B/cycle plateau of stg4 / stg8 W = 8 (10-11 / 23, 15-17 / 23) and totals 82 % < 85 %. Established: every saturated cell ends at the installed store port rate (32 B/cycle per SM, both devices); the first-plateau rate before the port binds depends on the request size in a way neither declared structure carries (128 B: 64 B/cycle after ~4 KB; 256 B: 85-146 B/cycle; 512 B: 64 B/cycle at W = 4 from the first request, ~85 B/cycle at W = 8); total buffering before the port-bound plateau ~8-16 KB. No queue installed; a v6 would have to declare the request-size dependence of the acceptance stage before new data.

addenda.written: before the engine gate (full-gpu-chain-report §29); no new measurement
addenda.text: Rule S (declared from installed leaves only): the §11 change made LSU stores issue-and-forget (no SM-side acceptance), which removed every store backpressure; HW shows lg_throttle 26 % on cutlass tma_ws epilogues and single-cluster cutlass GEMMs sit at 0.93-1.0 while full-gpu at 0.57-0.73 (gpu-shared). Structure: each SM's store path holds at most store_l2.outstanding_requests (memory_request protocol: h100 43) warp-level store requests that the shared L2 write service has not yet drained; a global / generic LSU store (STG / ST; STL and reductions / atomics excluded) issued when the buffer is full stalls the issuing warp (lg_throttle) until the oldest request's drain end; drain end = the request's shared-L2-write service end (MemoryHierarchy::store `when` after service_shared(shared_l2_write_)). Per-SMSP store issue interval (installed kind 65) and the per-SM store port stay as they are. The byte-capacity acceptance stage of v5 (8-16 KB, no fitted structure) is not used: the request-count buffer is the installed measured leaf and the gpu-shared drain is the first-order term when all SMs store at once. Gate: full-gpu 500x2 vs full-r6 and single-cluster vs sc-r6 (sc kernels with large epilogues will move; the sc MAPE is the gate).
